faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the One Stop Centre Sri Sathya Sai Security Guard/Night Guard recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the One Stop Centre Sri Sathya Sai Security Guard/Night Guard recruitment is 29th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Security Guard/Night Guard post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Security Guard/Night Guard post will receive a salary of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 42 years for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies released?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been released for the Security Guard/Night Guard post.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Security Guard/Night Guard post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have at least 2 years of experience as security personnel in a government or reputed organization at the district/state level. Retired military/para-military personnel are preferred.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Security Guard/Night Guard position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Security Guard/Night Guard position will be based on Document Verification.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of One Stop Centre Sri Sathya Sai, which is srisathyasai.ap.gov.in. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section.
